load_coco_with_attributes_json: load a COCO JSON file with attribute support into Detectron2 dataset dicts
register_coco_instances_with_attributes: register COCO instances with attributes in the Detectron2 DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog
register_all_vg: register all predefined Visual Genome train, val, and test splits at a given root directory
review_load_coco_with_attributes_json: review the load_coco_with_attributes_json function to understand how it parses COCO annotations with attribute IDs
summarize_PREDEFINED_SPLITS_VG: summarize the predefined Visual Genome dataset splits for train, val, and test
